C dep012.ui-not-raw-openapi OL DEP-012 DECIDED ;; The developer-facing requirement is the interactive Swagger UI, not a standalone raw OpenAPI endpoint. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.swashbuckle-package OL DEP-012,DEP-003 DECIDED ;; Use Swashbuckle.AspNetCore with the version selected through add-dependency. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc008.swagger-in-api OL ARC-008,ARC-012 MUST ;; Keep Swagger configuration in the API/composition layer. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-launch-profile EX API-017 DEFAULT ;; For a new local Development API configure the launch profile to open Swagger when helpful; application HTTP/HTTPS URLs must agree with the launch profile (no HTTPS launch URL on an HTTP-only port). ;; = ;; When that helps. ;; Launch-profile technique outside the oracle (EXC-008).
C api016.metadata-accuracy OL API-016 MUST ;; Do not document 201 when returning 200 or 204 with a body; consider the whole pipeline (binding, validation, auth, rate limiting, central handling, middleware) but do not add theoretically possible statuses. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.document-201 OL API-016 MUST ;; Document 201 Created only when that is the runtime contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.error-contracts-doc OL API-016,API-008 MUST ;; Describe ProblemDetails/ValidationProblemDetails contracts where useful; never put internal exception types, stack traces, SQL, connection strings or paths in Swagger examples/descriptions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api016.auth-metadata OL API-016 MUST ;; Configure security definitions/requirements only when the API actually uses authentication; do not add a scheme merely because a package is installed; do not apply auth requirements globally to anonymous endpoints. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-bearer-scheme EX API-016,DEP-012 DEFAULT ;; For Bearer authentication expose a Bearer scheme so authenticated endpoints can be exercised from Swagger UI. ;; = ;; When the API uses Bearer auth. ;; Usability configuration beyond API-016's accuracy requirement.
C x.sw-descriptions EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Document consumer-relevant contract information (preconditions, idempotency, pagination/filtering, outcomes); avoid descriptions that repeat action/property names. ;; = ;; none ;; Documentation-content guidance not in the oracle.
C x.sw-xml-docs EX GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; XML comments only when the project chooses them for public contracts; do not add them to every internal type solely for Swagger. ;; = ;; Project chooses XML docs. ;; Documentation practice outside the oracle.
C x.sw-multiple-docs EX API-016 MUST_NOT ;; Use multiple Swagger documents only for a real contract separation (API versions, public/internal surfaces). ;; = ;; none ;; Document-partitioning technique outside the oracle (EXC-008).
C wf016.generated-client-review OL WF-016,API-014,API-016 MUST ;; When the contract feeds client generation treat breaking schema changes seriously, keep metadata accurate and review generated-client changes when the contract changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-client-contracts EX ARC-029,API-016 AVOID ;; Avoid unstable anonymous response shapes and anonymous objects as long-lived contracts; use explicit request/response contracts. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit-contract requirement for generated clients is not stated in the oracle (ARC-029 only discourages gratuitous DTO duplication).
C x.sw-not-tests EX TST-006 AVOID ;; Avoid treating Swagger as a substitute for integration tests. ;; = ;; none ;; Anti-pattern not in the oracle.
C dep012.no-competing-docs OL DEP-012,DEP-002 AVOID ;; Avoid adding a second competing API-documentation stack without a concrete need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf006.api-change-verify OL WF-005,WF-006,API-016 MUST ;; When API behaviour changes verify Controller behaviour and relevant integration tests, response metadata, and start the API when startup/composition is affected. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sw-verify EX WF-006,DEP-012 MUST ;; Open the Development Swagger UI to confirm it loads and exercise representative endpoints through it when meaningful. ;; = ;; When a meaningful behavioural check. ;; Swagger-UI-specific verification step beyond the oracle.
C tst010.preserve-verified OL TST-010 MUST ;; Preserve newly verified behaviour in maintained tests (verify step 4). ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.tm-user-only EX - ENFORCED ;; template-maintenance runs only when the user invokes it; Claude must not start it automatically (disable-model-invocation: true). ;; = ;; none ;; Invocation restriction on a repo/meta workflow; not an oracle policy.
C x.tm-one-owner EX - MUST ;; One authoritative owner per policy; elsewhere only routing pointers or yes/no check-by-reference, never reworded copies; decision summaries only in CLAUDE.md Architecture Defaults and docs/technology-stack.md; edit the owner in place and replace other copies with pointers. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-ownership invariant (repo/meta) not in the oracle.
C x.tm-policy-at-trigger EX - MUST ;; Keep each policy at its trigger (planning-time policy in CLAUDE.md/technology-stack, area constraints in flat path-scoped rules, procedures in workflow skills); do not promote content into CLAUDE.md for easier loading nor demote planning-time policy to save tokens. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-placement invariant (repo/meta).
C x.tm-compact EX - MUST ;; Keep CLAUDE.md, docs/technology-stack.md and skill descriptions compact; descriptions start with concrete triggers. ;; = ;; none ;; Context-size and description-style invariant (repo/meta).
C x.tm-hook-messages EX - MUST ;; Hooks fail visibly and point messages at the owning file instead of restating policy. ;; = ;; none ;; Hook-design invariant (repo/meta).
C x.tm-test-hooks EX WF-005 MUST ;; For hook or script changes run the changed script with sample input and confirm both pass and failure paths. ;; = ;; none ;; Verification obligation for instruction-system scripts beyond the oracle.
C x.tm-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report files changed, owners added or moved, and the checker result after template maintenance. ;; = ;; none ;; Output-shape obligation of the maintenance workflow.
